segments.evidence: We operate our business as a single operating segment that provides premium content through multiple channels, including the use of various applications, partnerships and affiliate relationships.

revenueModel.text: Subscription fees from direct-to-consumer and partner platforms, content licensing fees, bundled distribution fees, and advertising and sponsorship revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: The main sources of our revenue are: 1. Subscription and license fees earned from our Direct-to-Consumer business and Partner Direct subscribers ("Direct Business"), 2. Other revenue, including advertising and sponsorships ("Other").
